sentences.text:
Author: Asha Arora
Bench: Asha Arora
8.2.2017 C.R.R. No. 2060 of 2009
 (sg ) In re : M/s. R.K. Agro Products & Anr. .. Petitioners
Re : An application under Sections 401/482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Mr. Debjani Sahu .. for the opposite party no.1/State None appears for the petitioners on call.

The judgement and order dated December 19, 2008 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Fast Track 3rd Court, Calcutta in Criminal Appeal No. 79 of 2007affirming the judgement and order dated July 25, 2007 passed by the learned Senior Municipal Magistrate, Calcutta in Case No. 20D of 2003 has been assailed by the petitioners/accused.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge, Fast Track 3rd Court, Calcutta
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: By the aforesaid judgement and order dated July 25, 2007 the petitioner no.1 has been convicted for the offence punishable under Section 16(1)(a)(i) read with Section 7 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced to pay a fine of Rs.2000/- while the petitioner no.2 has been convicted for the aforesaid offence and sentenced to suffer rigorous imprisonment for six months and to pay a fine of Rs.2000/- in default of which to suffer simple imprisonment for three months for the offence punishable under Section 16(1)(a)(i) read with Section 7 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.
I do not find any illegality in the judgement and order impugned.
Therefore, no interference is warranted with the same.
The application being C.R.R. 2060 of 2009 is thus dismissed.
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
The trial court shall proceed against the petitioners in accordance with law for execution of the sentence.
A copy of this order be sent forthwith to the trial court for information and necessary action.

( Asha Arora, J. )
